results.title: Brick Wars
results.overview: A group of special agents fight to stop the evil plans of Dr. Inferno.

results.title: Billy Knight
results.overview: After losing his father, Alex discovers a box of unfinished scripts and a handkerchief with the name “Billy Knight” embroidered on it. Consumed with the desire to discover his identity, Alex embarks on a Hollywood adventure to track down this mysterious and reclusive Billy Knight.

results.title: Gloss
results.overview: A trans teen comes out to their mother who is struggling to reveal her own monstrous secret.

results.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 2
results.overview: The second night of G1 Climax 36 took place on July 18, 2026, at Hokkaido Prefectural Sports Center in Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan, and was headlined by an A Block match between Hirooki Goto and Yota Tsuji.

results.title: Return to Shadow Valley
results.overview: Return to Shadow Valley is a blood-soaked love letter to classic 1980s zombie and creature-feature horror—packed with undead mayhem, practical monster effects, cursed desert legends, and all-night Halloween party chaos. Set in an abandoned desert cemetery where the dead refuse to stay buried, the film unleashes a night of monsters, gore, and supernatural insanity beneath the sands of Shadow Valley.

results.title: OnlyFans: Inside the Machine
results.overview: Amber Haque reveals how OnlyFans models suffer widespread exploitation and coercion at the hands of their managers.

results.title: Bug Bite
results.overview: On a remote Australian farm, a weary farmer crosses paths with a wounded stranger desperate for help. What begins as an uneasy act of kindness quickly spirals into a nightmarish fight for survival, as something far more sinister than an injury reveals itself.

results.title: I Deserve a Lover Whose Every Rise Sets Fiery Dooms Raging Across the Skies
results.original_title: مرا عاشق چنان باید که هر باری که برخیزد قیامت‌های پرآتش ز هر سویی برانگیزد
results.overview: Set between Tabriz and Tehran in the weeks between the Twelve-Day War and the subsequent conflict between Iran, Israel, and the United States, this film follows two Iranian artists whose lives have become inseparable from a vast private archive assembled over decades: photographs, documents, discarded objects, and traces of anonymous lives. Working somewhere between collecting, hoarding, preservation, and obsession, they have created an improvised museum of neglected lives, one in which sex workers, young soldiers, child labourers, gay lovers, and ordinary families emerge through abandoned albums, damaged belongings, and fragments of memory left behind by history.

results.title: My Best Friend's Secret Boyfriend
results.overview: A couple expecting their first child finds their relationship pushed to the brink when buried secrets, lies and betrayal begin to surface. A woman obsessed always gets what she wants, even if it comes at the ultimate price.

results.title: Abandoned
results.overview: Chasing a viral video to save their channel and friendship, two urban explorers break into a derelict facility scarred by sinister experiments. Trapped among its secrets, they enter a nightmare where history manifests as evil.

results.title: Tales of the Macabre
results.overview: On Halloween night 1984, a grief-stricken late-night radio host shares the legend of the Crimson Witch with his listeners, but as exhaustion takes hold, he begins to fear the story may be coming to life.

results.title: The Ovijan
results.overview: Upcoming Eid UL Adha drama of Bangladesh 2026

results.title: Common Man
results.overview: Raghav is a common man struggling for good life and peace of mind. But unnecessary disorder in obeying rules by others, irritates him a lot. One day he decides to teach lesson to such people. And He traps himself into huge trouble.

results.title: Smudge the Blades
results.overview: Treaty 6 Blades, an under-18 hockey team from an Alberta reservation, face their last season together while navigating their tough northern league.

results.title: Comeback Dad
results.overview: An out-of-shape comedian and his 17-year-old son set off on a last-minute road trip. Unable to see eye to eye, these two polar opposites of masculinity clash inside a cramped car. Amidst conflicts and emotions, they discover they need to view the world from each other's perspective to finally understand one another.

results.title: The Only One
results.overview: When her exes are suddenly being murdered one by one, suspicion falls on Zoe and it's up to her and a ragtag team of old friends to prove her innocence and figure out the identity of the masked Prince Charming killer.

results.title: The Past Is Never Buried
results.overview: Emily, desperate to find answers about her mother's murder 22 years prior, returns to her hometown when her father, also a suspect in her mother's death, is arrested for the homicide of a local teenager.

results.title: The Shipwrecked
results.overview: Thirty years ago, Diego Gutiérrez moved to the Netherlands. For his latest film, he returned to Mexico, seeking answers to lingering questions. How do you cope with loneliness and grief? How do you connect with nature? Is an easier life in a less dangerous country also a better life?

results.title: Meurtres à Fontainebleau
results.overview: When a murder revives the legend of the "Grand Veneur", the forest of Fontainebleau becomes the hunting ground of an elusive killer.
